enrichment.why: A marksman with a full dive/pick kit — Chimera overheat explosion, Close The Deal grab-slam, plus a genuine shred/mark gun package — so on paper he is a lane-to-hub skirmisher, not a backline turret. But he is a flyer in an explicitly anti-flyer patch (air drag 35%, slows hit him airborne by his own tooltip, Silver's Bola grounds), so his signature mobility is a tax, not an edge. The 34.9% WR over 0.2% PR is novelty-deflated, but the kit and item scatter do not contradict the bad signal.

builds.name: Shred/mark gun
builds.notes: Jettison Fuel's bullet-resist shred stacked with Bullet Resist Shredder amplifies the marksman damage; HV Rounds (86% pick) and Express Shot carry the charged-shot mark-consume.

builds.name: Ability burst
builds.notes: Scales Strix Salvo marks plus Close The Deal and overheat-dive spirit explosions; 36% late Boundless Spirit pick shows players testing it.

builds.name: Dive bruiser
builds.notes: Survivability to blunt the whiff-self-stun and always-explode-on-death pattern; no clear payoff yet — Fortitude shows 9% win late.

enrichment.matchup_notes: He threatens squishy, grouped or immobile carries he can mark with Salvo then burst with a dive or Close The Deal. He loses to anti-air and disruption: Silver's Weighted Bola grounds flyers on top of out-trading him, Lash can fling him out of dives, and Apollo out-lanes him. Silences/knockdowns and a whiffed dive (self-stun) are his own worst enemy given the 38s respawn tax.
enabled_by: Grouped hub fights (Sunken Plaza, Bell Tower) that reward the overheat-dive AoE and launch
AoE clear of grouped Haunt camps
An anchor/initiator teammate to hold targets so Strix Salvo marks and Close The Deal land
countered_by: Silence / Knockdown / Silencing Hex / Bebop hook
Slows — doubled by the global air-drag tax plus his own airborne-slow tooltip
Plated Armor vs his gun; Debuff Reducer vs his mark and fading slow
His own no-hero-hit self-stun combined with the long death tax
enrichment.notes: Provisional C on a ~2-day sample; 34.9% WR / 0.2% PR is novelty-deflated but directionally bad, and the build pool is unformed (many 0-20% win picks). Would revise up if WR clears ~45% as PR grows and a mark/charged-shot build consolidates; down if the flyer tax holds and no build lands.

card.headline: Reckless flying marksman with a dive-bomb and grab-slam — high ceiling, anti-flyer meta.
kit_read: Chimera Mk1: jetpack flight builds heat; the overheat dive explodes and launches nearby enemies — but self-stuns if it hits no hero, and he always explodes on death.
Strix Salvo: a line of spirit missiles marks targets; a charged shot consumes the mark for bonus spirit damage and a fading slow.
Close The Deal: grab a hero, fly up, slam — spirit DoT plus impact damage, amped vs targets under 50% HP (T3 adds a stun).
Jettison Fuel: weapon-DoT spray that shreds bullet resist and builds to a spirit backblast knockback; also vents the jetpack.
Frame: 680 HP and 116 heavy melee (opens Tough Crates), mixed gun/spirit — picks with dives, farms with AoE.
card.meta_fit: His AoE (overheat explosion, Salvo) clears grouped Haunt camps and his heavy melee opens Tough Crates, and forced hub fights reward the dive — but he is a flyer in a patch built to tax flyers, and 38s respawns make every whiffed self-stun dive expensive.
threatens: Seven — squishy grouped spirit carry; Salvo mark plus dive/Close The Deal chunks him
Celeste — burst spirit carry with no escape from the grab
Graves — immobile split pusher, an easy Close The Deal target
threatened_by: Silver — Bola grounds flyers on top of being a gun-tank that out-trades him
Lash — mobile initiator flings him out of dives
Silence / Knockdown / Silencing Hex — locks the jetpack and Close The Deal mid-dive
Plated Armor vs his gun; Debuff Reducer vs his mark and slow
card.build_read: The only coherent build so far is hybrid: High-Velocity Rounds + Express Shot for the charged-shot/mark gun package, Bullet Resist Shredder stacked with Jettison Fuel, Superior Cooldown for uptime, Boundless Spirit late. Item data is scattered (many 0-20% win picks) — nobody has converged, so the meta build is still unformed.
what_to_watch: WR as PR rises past novelty — does 34.9% climb toward ~45%?
Whether a mark/charged-shot build consolidates around Express Shot + Bullet Resist Shredder
Any flyer-tax easing (air drag, slows) or Silver Bola nerf that un-taxes his core mobility
